tools.name: search_airports
tools.description: Find airport IATA codes by city, airport name, metro area, or code.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of airport results to return.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query for airport names, city names, or airport codes.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search one-way or round-trip flight prices between two IATA airport codes. Returns only itineraries with a preferred booking link and includes a top-level booking_url for each itinerary.

params.name: market
params.description: 2-letter market or country code affecting pricing and results.

params.name: origin
params.description: Origin airport code for flight search.

params.name: max_price
params.description: Maximum price in the selected market currency for flight results.

params.name: max_stops
params.description: Maximum number of stops allowed in the flight itinerary.

params.name: cabin_class
params.description: Preferred cabin class: economy, premium_economy, business, or first.

params.name: destination
params.description: Destination airport code for flight search.

params.name: max_results
params.description: Maximum number of flight results to return.

params.name: return_date
params.description: Optional return date in YYYY-MM-DD format for round-trip flights.

params.name: infants_on_lap
params.description: Number of infants traveling on an adult's lap.
